title: Crystal Nights (2008)
summary: A short story by science fiction author Greg Egan exploring themes of consciousness, identity, and reality through a crystalline/algorithmic lens. The piece, published in 2008, exemplifies Egan's signature style of integrating hard science fiction concepts with philosophical inquiry.
problem_solved: Delivers a narrative exploration of consciousness and identity through speculative scientific concepts.
why_valuable: Greg Egan is renowned for his rigorous treatment of scientific and philosophical themes, making this piece valuable for readers interested in the intersection of mathematics, physics, and consciousness.
